model: Historical standardized nearest neighbors k50, fixed
validation: Last three years of historically generated out-of-fold scores, only labels mature by selection time
fallback: threshold0.10; price/crossing for live selector if no adequately supported validation
training: Annual expanding fit on mature-frontier samples; feature standardization on training only
negative_label_policy: Window ends no later than latest pivot mature at training cutoff
warning: All candidates and thresholds are research attempts, including failures. Historical scores are not future evidence.
